title: Jamaican Feta Hash
description: A spicy and savory breakfast dish made with feta cheese, a hint of Jamaican spices, and a crunchy hash.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together crumbled feta cheese, chopped nutty, and Jamaican seasoning.
Add diced hash to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Place cubed aerated bread on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
In a skillet, cook the feta-hash mixture over medium heat until the cheese is melted and the hash is crispy.
Serve the feta-hash mixture over toasted bread and enjoy!
Optional: top with additional chopped nutty or a fried egg for extra flavor and texture.
